claims.claim_text: The Board is the governance body responsible for oversight of climate-related risks and opportunities.
evidence_sources: Draft markdown: Governance > 1.1 Board oversight, agenda integration and reporting flow
claims.support_notes: Identifies the governance body responsible for oversight, but does not describe how responsibilities are reflected in terms of reference/mandates/role descriptions/policies.
No underlying evidence provided (e.g., corporate governance statement/annual report/board composition register).

claims.claim_text: The Board holds four full board meetings per year.
claims.support_notes: No evidence cited (e.g., board calendar, governance report).

claims.claim_text: Climate-related matters are included on the Board agenda 69.8% of the time.
claims.support_notes: Addresses frequency/regularity of board engagement, but no evidence (agenda analysis, sample agendas, methodology) is provided.

claims.claim_text: Climate risk reporting is provided to the Board on a semi-annual basis.
claims.support_notes: Meets the 'how often informed' conceptually, but lacks corroborating evidence (reporting calendar, board packs, minutes).

claims.claim_text: Board minutes record that climate-related topics discussed include transition plan review, scenario analysis, TCFD review, net zero progress, carbon credit approval and executive remuneration ESG KPIs.
claims.support_notes: Would support board oversight and remuneration/targets oversight, but minutes are not provided or referenced with dates/meeting identifiers.

claims.claim_text: Management responsibility for climate-related matters is delegated to the Climate Risk Management Committee.
evidence_sources: Draft markdown: Governance > 1.2 Management-level responsibility and committee structures
claims.support_notes: Identifies a management-level committee, but does not explain how oversight is exercised over the committee (mandate, reporting lines, authority).

claims.claim_text: An ESG committee is established and meets seven times per year.
claims.support_notes: No evidence provided (committee charter, meeting calendar, minutes). Also does not describe oversight exercised over the committee.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risks and opportunities are integrated into the organisation’s enterprise risk management (ERM) processes.
evidence_sources: Draft markdown: Governance > 1.3 ERM integration and major-transaction climate checks
claims.support_notes: States integration but does not describe controls/procedures or how integrated with internal functions; no evidence (risk taxonomy, risk register extracts, ERM policy).

claims.claim_text: A climate check for major transactions applies, meaning climate-related risks and opportunities are considered when evaluating major transactions.
claims.support_notes: Addresses consideration of climate in major transactions, but lacks detail on process, thresholds, governance owner, and evidence (investment committee policy, transaction checklists).

claims.claim_text: 37.5% of the Board is assessed as having climate expertise.
evidence_sources: Draft markdown: Governance > 1.4 Skills, competence and development programme
claims.support_notes: Provides a quantified indicator but does not explain assessment criteria/method, nor how the board determines skills are available/will be developed.

claims.claim_text: A skills development programme applies to support development of relevant skills and competencies for sustainability and climate oversight.
claims.support_notes: Mentions development programme but lacks description (content, frequency, participants) and evidence (training plan, attendance records).

claims.claim_text: Across the executive population, 15.1% of executive remuneration is linked to climate-related measures.
evidence_sources: Draft markdown: Governance > 1.5 Executive remuneration linkage and governance information used in decision-making
claims.support_notes: Addresses inclusion of climate metrics in remuneration, but lacks definition of 'executive population', calculation basis, and evidence (remuneration policy, scorecards).

claims.claim_text: Board minutes record that executive remuneration ESG KPIs are among the climate-related topics discussed by the Board.
claims.support_notes: Would evidence board oversight of remuneration linkage, but minutes are not provided or referenced with meeting identifiers.
